name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola Petrović's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with engines in his grandfather's Belgrade workshop. While his peers played football, Nikola was dissecting carburetors and dreaming of Formula 1. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, but quickly realized his passion lay more in the operational aspects of racing teams. He started as a junior mechanic, quickly climbing the ranks due to his sharp eye for detail and ability to optimize team processes. 

Nikola's approach to operations is relentless. He believes in meticulous planning, data-driven decision-making, and pushing every team member to reach their full potential. He's not afraid to challenge established norms and is always looking for innovative ways to improve efficiency. His demanding nature is balanced by a genuine commitment to developing talent within the team, earning him a reputation as a tough but ultimately rewarding leader. What sets Nikola apart is his ability to translate complex technical information into actionable strategies, bridging the gap between the engineers and the drivers.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade.
physical.description: Nikola is of average height with a lean build and intense, focused eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against the table when deep in thought.
Insists on a perfectly clean and organized pit garage, and personally ensures it is so before each race.
